cli.description: {app}: replaces passwords, tokens, IPs etc. with placeholders like [PASSWORD_1]. Without arguments the GUI starts.
cli.hint: Hint: Always check the results yourself.
cli.help.inputs: File(s) or folder(s). '-' reads from stdin and writes to stdout.
cli.help.output: Output folder (default: <input folder>_sanitized next to the input).
cli.help.no_personal: Do NOT replace personal data (email, names).
cli.help.profile: Use the rules (and, if present, mode/categories) of a profile instead of your own rules: name of a profile saved in the GUI or path to a profile file.
cli.help.export_profile: Export your own rules, allowlist, mode and categories as a profile and exit.
cli.help.with_wordlists: With --export-profile: also export the word lists (they contain names in plain text!).
cli.help.output_encoding: Encoding of the output files (default utf-8, 'same' = like the input).
cli.help.exclude: Skip folders/files in a folder run, e.g. --exclude "*.bak" (can be repeated, in addition to the default patterns like .git, node_modules).
cli.help.sanitize_filenames: Also sanitize folder and file names (e.g. backup_[HOSTNAME_1].log); the report then shows only the sanitized names.
cli.help.no_office: Do not sanitize Word/Excel/PowerPoint, skip them like binary files.
cli.help.keep_office_media: Keep images and embedded objects in Office documents (default: remove them, because they cannot be checked).
cli.help.no_pdf: Do not read PDFs (otherwise: text as sanitized <name>.pdf.txt).
cli.help.no_archives: Do not unpack archives (.zip, .tar, .tar.gz, .gz), skip them like binary files.
cli.help.workers: CPU cores for folder runs (default: automatic, 1 = single core).
cli.help.no_exclude: Use no exclude patterns (not even the default ones).
cli.help.no_report: Do not write a report file to the output folder.
cli.help.clean: Empty the output folder first (only if it is empty or comes from an earlier run).
cli.help.check: Check only, write nothing: lists files with findings (without values) and exits with code {code} if anything was found (e.g. for pre-commit hooks).
cli.help.lang: Language of the output (default: environment variable SECRET_SANITIZER_LANG, then setting, then system language).
cli.binary_stdin: Input is not a text file (binary data).
cli.skipped_large: Skipped (too large, {size} MB): {rel}  -> use --yes to process anyway
cli.gui_missing:
The GUI needs the customtkinter package:
    pip install -r requirements.txt
The command line also works without it: python -m secret_sanitizer --help
